reuse.why: Changes only the shared getExpectedScheduleAmount that every consumer already calls, but the rewritten approximate branch still computes Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075) inline instead of calling getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.

duplication.why: The rule stays in one function; the only duplication is the 7.5% tolerance formula, rewritten in place rather than taken from the existing threshold helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, where every planning, posting and preview path already reads it.

scope.why: A two-line rule change plus matching comment and test updates.

maintainability.why: Simple and centralised; the tolerance could drift from the one used for matching because it is not shared.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount in shared/schedules.ts recomputes the approximate tolerance instead of using getApproxNumberThreshold (shared/rules.ts).

disguised_duplication.where: The inline tolerance is a literal copy of getApproxNumberThreshold's formula, not disguised.
